ADDED TO UNCONTESTED CALENDAR FOR Osc For Change Of Name
Off Calendar Nov-18-2002 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause comes on calendar regularly as scheduled for Petition Changing Name. Present: Commissioner Loretta M. Norris; Clerk: P. Dias; Reporter: Patrick Heald. Petitioner is sworn and examined. The Court grants the decree changing minors' names to Joline Melody Tam and Brendon Christian Tam. Decree signed in open court.
